basic_info.description: Welcome home to  beach life. This house and neighborhood are so chill they could be prescribed as blood pressure medication... Enjoy the dance of sun, clouds and ocean breezes from your living room as you debate between paddling out, a walk on the beach or maybe a bike ride along the great Highway. Stop by Hook Fish, two blocks away for some tacos and a beverage or stroll to Andytown for a cappuccino. Yes, you can have it all, especially when your new home features updated kitchen and baths, lighting upgrades throughout and a sprawling, terraced rear garden. And by the way, it has an elevator.
